## Main hypothesis

> **H0 (null)**: On LLaDA-V, no refresh policy beats fixed-interval refresh: at matched quality, its wall-clock is
> not significantly lower than fixed interval k at the anchors k = 2 / 4 / 8.
>
> **H1 (alternative)**: Some cheap policy cuts matched-quality wall-clock by ≥ 25% on ≥ 2 anchors, Holm-significant,
> reaching ≥ 50% of the oracle's gain (gate G4).

- Matched quality: not significantly below the anchor (paired test) and within 1 accuracy point (or 0.01 Jaccard).
- Tests: McNemar (exact) on correctness; Wilcoxon signed-rank on wall-clock and agreement; Holm over 3 anchors.
- Uncertainty: paired bootstrap `Δ [95% CI] (n)` over samples; deterministic decoding, one run per arm.
- Thresholds frozen 2026-10-27 (`.claude/research.md`).

## Supporting claims

- [**C 1**]{#c1} (reproduction): our loop equals upstream, and our fixed-interval frontier matches the published one.
  - Evidence: [Exp 2](experiments/exp2_loop_identity.qmd) (30/30 identical), [Exp 3](experiments/exp3_mme_frontier.qmd).
  - Falsification: G1 thresholds (±20% speedup, ±0.05 Jaccard, monotone).
- [**C 2**]{#c2} (concentration): replacement error is concentrated in a few (position group × layer × step) cells.
  - Evidence needed: Exp 5 error map, D1–D5.
  - Falsification: top 20% of cells hold < 50% of top-1 flips on every main task (G2).
- [**C 3**]{#c3} (headroom): a hindsight-optimal schedule is ≥ 40% faster than fixed interval at matched quality.
  - Evidence needed: Phase 3 oracle.
  - Falsification: < 40% on 2 or more of the anchors k = 2 / 4 / 8 (G3).
- [**C 4**]{#c4} (policy): a static or cheap online policy reaches the G4 bar.
  - Evidence needed: Phase 4 policies vs fixed interval and same-budget random refresh.
  - Falsification: G4 not met.
- [**C 5**]{#c5} (metric): near k = 2, agreement with full recompute measures trajectory choice, not caption quality.
  - Evidence: [Obs 1](experiments/obs1_frontier_bad_cases.qmd) (k = 2 vs k = 4 agree 0.63 ≈ k = 2 vs full 0.61;
    3 of 4 worst captions as good or better).
  - Falsification: on MathVerse, accuracy at k = 2 falls ≥ 1 point below full with McNemar p < 0.05.

## Assumptions and risks

- **Error is not uniform** — if it is, fixed interval is near-optimal (C 2 fails).
  - Response (user decision 2026-10-29): no pivot to an analysis paper; read bad cases for an improvement lever.
- **Trajectories are chaotic** — tiny changes flip whole captions (Obs 1: 15/50 flips from parallel decoding alone).
  - Mitigation: task accuracy as primary metric; paired tests; 3-seed sign check in the appendix.
- **Gains overlap with Elastic-Cache** — novelty would shrink.
  - Mitigation: stacking experiment in Phase 5 (port deferred until G2 / G3).
- **Index overhead** — lower r but no wall-clock gain.
  - Mitigation: refresh contiguous groups and layer ranges; always report wall-clock.
